description: Reports how busy the arena is: {depth_total, depth_by_mode, plays_last_2h_total, plays_last_2h_by_mode, plays_per_hour}. depth_* counts real fighters holding in the lobby (by_mode is filtered to your preferred modes); plays_* counts matches started in the last 2 hours. Works without an identity and creates no fighter. The same block rides lobby join_match and query_my_next_match responses. Side effects: Before returning lobby depth and the recent play rate, it can reconnect a fighter by replacing its persistent notification route with this session.
name: query_queue
